t: This is Hammersmith Hospital, a major teaching hospital in White City, next to Wormwood Scrubs and East Acton. Despite the name, it isn't in Hammersmith. It was formerly the Military Orthopaedic Hospital, and later the Special Surgical Hospital. Today it's part of Imperial College Healthcare NHS Trust and is associated with the Imperial College Faculty of Medicine. Several notable people are linked to it. The broadcasting pioneer Peter Eckersley, the BBC's first chief engineer, died here, as did the coin designer and sculptor Percy Metcalfe, and the Labour MP Piara Khabra, the first Sikh to become a British MP.
